title: Great tour of the Cathedral
text: The Cathedral is a must see in Seville. It's beyond fascinating, and really helps to have someone telling you some extra interesting things. Our fantastic guide, Xavier, made this visit even more wonderful. My only regret is not being able to spend another few hours listening and asking questions! The company was very easy to communicate with.
author: Lindsay_G

title: Jenkins review
text: Very busy. Definitely need a professional and informative guide like Camilla, who was very good and managed the group well.
author: David_J

title: Cathedral tour with Alvaro
text: Highly recommend this tour! Alvaro was very knowledgeable and made the tour very interesting for us.
author: 496seemaj

title: Great tour!!!
text: Alvaro was an amazing tour guide. He really brought the city of Seville to life through the cathedral and city tour. Extremely knowledgeable, easy to understand in English, and such a great and friendly personality. I would highly recommend.

title: Seville cathedral with Alvaro!
text: Alvaro was incredible!  So enthusiastic, incredibly knowledgeable, and easy to understand. Any tour you book-book with Alvaro!
